description: This PHP source file defines the PollyClient class, which extends AwsClient to interact with the Amazon Polly service. It includes methods for generating pre-signed URLs for speech synthesis requests, and contains method annotations for various Polly operations.

classes.name: PollyClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the Amazon Polly service, providing methods such as createSynthesizeSpeechPreSignedUrl to generate pre-signed URLs for speech synthesis.

methods.name: createSynthesizeSpeechPreSignedUrl
methods.description: Creates a pre-signed URL for the SynthesizeSpeech Polly operation, allowing temporary access to speech synthesis functionality.
